name: claude-session-manager
description: Desktop app for managing multiple Claude Code CLI sessions

scripts.build: tsc --build --force && npm run bundle-state && npm run copy-assets
scripts.copy-assets: cp src/renderer/index.html dist/src/renderer/ && cp src/renderer/styles.css dist/src/renderer/
scripts.watch: tsc -p tsconfig.json --watch & tsc -p tsconfig.renderer.json --watch & npm run bundle-state -- --watch
